children: Cantor Equity Partners V will hold its annual general meeting on December 29, 2026, and consider reappointing two Class I directors.
The AGM is scheduled for December 29, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time in New York.
Shareholder proposals must be delivered to the company by December 6, 2026, and meet applicable requirements.
The meeting satisfies Nasdaq’s annual meeting requirement for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
Class B shareholders will consider reappointing Class I directors Dr. Mukesh Prasad and Charlotte Blechman.
